asterion01.title: The Ear of the Labyrinth
asterion01.t01.man: Cold. The stone of the ceiling was always warm. Today it is cold.
asterion01.t02.man: I knock on the stone. Up there, someone always keeps the stone warm. Today no one answers.
asterion01.h.wall.1: Under his fingers, the letters he scratched himself, year after year. And among them, always the same sign: a circle cut by a line. A closed eye.
asterion01.h.wall.lit: Today the eye is warm. It glows for an instant under his hand, as if, somewhere up there, someone had looked at it.
asterion01.h.bed.1: The old straw keeps his shape, curled up like a calf. In the middle, a deeper hollow: where he presses his head when the stone goes cold.
asterion01.h.bone.1: An ox bone, gnawed many winters ago. It isn't his. It's food. He needs to remember that sometimes.
asterion01.h.chain.1: A ring in the wall and a broken chain. This one is his. Its mark is still on his neck.
asterion01.t03.man: A smell. Bread. A boy's sweat. Lamp oil.
asterion01.d01: It's me. Mirto. No need to make that face, I know you heard me since the bend.
asterion01.d02: Up there the Temple's flame did something strange tonight. The Vestals are as jumpy as hens on a feast day.
asterion01.d03a: One of them, the novice, swears she heard knocking under the altar. That was you, wasn't it?
asterion01.d04: My father said not to be long. He says one day you'll eat me. I say you don't like skinny boys.
asterion01.c01: Mirto holds out the bread, right up to his muzzle.
asterion01.c01.take: Take the bread from his hand.
asterion01.c01.wait: Wait for him to leave it on the ground.
asterion01.t04a.man: His hand doesn't shake. No hand has ever come this close without shaking.
asterion01.t04b.man: Better on the ground. Hands come close, and then come the spears.
asterion01.d05b: All right, all right. On the ground, like for a dog.
asterion01.d05c: Gods! Fine, I'll leave it here. Rude.
asterion01.t05.man: The ceiling stone cracks with cold. Up there, the fire wavered again, and the cold comes in through the horns.
asterion01.d06: Hey... hey. Are you all right? You're shaking.
asterion01.c02: You knock on the stone, don't you? I hear it from the stairs. Why?
asterion01.c02.mark: Show him the closed eye scratched on the wall.
asterion01.c02.knock: Knock on the stone, hard, until it cracks.
asterion01.t06a.man: He runs his finger over the closed eye, the way I do. He copies the sign onto a potsherd.
asterion01.d07a: A closed eye... Looks like it's sleeping. Or pretending. I'll ask the Vestals what it is.
asterion01.t06b.man: I don't know how to answer. So I don't.
asterion01.d07b: Fine. Keep your secrets, old bull. I'll be back tomorrow.
asterion01.t06c.man: The stone cracks. Up there, someone will hear.
asterion01.d07c: Stop! You'll bring it all down on us!
